a: اِسْمَعِي لِي أَيَّتُهَا الْجَزَائِرُ، وَاصْغَوْا أَيُّهَا الأُمَمُ مِنْ بَعِيدٍ: الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْبَطْنِ دَعَانِي. مِنْ أَحْشَاءِ أُمِّي ذَكَرَ اسْمِي،
e: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

a: وَجَعَلَ فَمِي كَسَيْفٍ حَادٍّ. فِي ظِلِّ يَدِهِ خَبَّأَنِي وَجَعَلَنِي سَهْمًا مَبْرِيًّا. فِي كِنَانَتِهِ أَخْفَانِي.
e: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

a: وَقَالَ لِي: «أَنْتَ عَبْدِي إِسْرَائِيلُ الَّذِي بِهِ أَتَمَجَّدُ».
e: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

a: أَمَّا أَنَا فَقُلْتُ: «عَبَثًا تَعِبْتُ. بَاطِلاً وَفَارِغًا أَفْنَيْتُ قُدْرَتِي. لكِنَّ حَقِّي عِنْدَ الرَّبِّ، وَعَمَلِي عِنْدَ إِلهِي».
e: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the LORD, and my work with my God.

a: وَالآنَ قَالَ الرَّبُّ جَابِلِي مِنَ الْبَطْنِ عَبْدًا لَهُ، لإِرْجَاعِ يَعْقُوبَ إِلَيْهِ، فَيَنْضَمُّ إِلَيْهِ إِسْرَائِيلُ فَأَتَمَجَّدُ فِي عَيْنَيِ الرَّبِّ، وَإِلهِي يَصِيرُ قُوَّتِي.
e: And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.

a: فَقَالَ: «قَلِيلٌ أَنْ تَكُونَ لِي عَبْدًا لإِقَامَةِ أَسْبَاطِ يَعْقُوبَ، وَرَدِّ مَحْفُوظِي إِسْرَائِيلَ. فَقَدْ جَعَلْتُكَ نُورًا لِلأُمَمِ لِتَكُونَ خَلاَصِي إِلَى أَقْصَى الأَرْضِ».
e: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

a: هكَذَا قَالَ الرَّبُّ فَادِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، قُدُّوسُهُ، لِلْمُهَانِ النَّفْسِ، لِمَكْرُوهِ الأُمَّةِ، لِعَبْدِ الْمُتَسَلِّطِينَ: «يَنْظُرُ مُلُوكٌ فَيَقُومُونَ. رُؤَسَاءُ فَيَسْجُدُونَ. لأَجْلِ الرَّبِّ الَّذِي هُوَ أَمِينٌ، وَقُدُّوسِ إِسْرَائِيلَ الَّذِي قَدِ اخْتَارَكَ».
e: Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

a: هكَذَا قَالَ الرَّبُّ: «فِي وَقْتِ الْقُبُولِ اسْتَجَبْتُكَ، وَفِي يَوْمِ الْخَلاَصِ أَعَنْتُكَ. فَأَحْفَظُكَ وَأَجْعَلُكَ عَهْدًا لِلشَّعْبِ، لإِقَامَةِ الأَرْضِ، لِتَمْلِيكِ أَمْلاَكِ الْبَرَارِيِّ،
e: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

a: قَائِلاً لِلأَسْرَى: اخْرُجُوا. لِلَّذِينَ فِي الظَّلاَمِ: اظْهَرُوا. عَلَى الطُّرُقِ يَرْعَوْنَ وَفِي كُلِّ الْهِضَابِ مَرْعَاهُمْ.
e: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.

a: لاَ يَجُوعُونَ وَلاَ يَعْطَشُونَ، وَلاَ يَضْرِبُهُمْ حَرٌّ وَلاَ شَمْسٌ، لأَنَّ الَّذِي يَرْحَمُهُمْ يَهْدِيهِمْ وَإِلَى يَنَابِيعِ الْمِيَاهِ يُورِدُهُمْ.
e: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

a: وَأَجْعَلُ كُلَّ جِبَالِي طَرِيقًا، وَمَنَاهِجِي تَرْتَفِعُ.
e: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

a: هؤُلاَءِ مِنْ بَعِيدٍ يَأْتُونَ، وَهؤُلاَءِ مِنَ الشَّمَالِ وَمِنَ الْمَغْرِبِ، وَهؤُلاَءِ مِنْ أَرْضِ سِينِيمَ».
e: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

a: تَرَنَّمِي أَيَّتُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ، وَابْتَهِجِي أَيَّتُهَا الأَرْضُ. لِتُشِدِ الْجِبَالُ بِالتَّرَنُّمِ، لأَنَّ الرَّبَّ قَدْ عَزَّى شَعْبَهُ، وَعَلَى بَائِسِيهِ يَتَرَحَّمُ.
e: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

a: وَقَالَتْ صِهْيَوْنُ: «قَدْ تَرَكَنِي الرَّبُّ، وَسَيِّدِي نَسِيَنِي».
e: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.

a: «هَلْ تَنْسَى الْمَرْأَةُ رَضِيعَهَا فَلاَ تَرْحَمَ ابْنَ بَطْنِهَا؟ حَتَّى هؤُلاَءِ يَنْسَيْنَ، وَأَنَا لاَ أَنْسَاكِ.
e: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

a: هُوَذَا عَلَى كَفَّيَّ نَقَشْتُكِ. أَسْوَارُكِ أَمَامِي دَائِمًا.
e: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

a: قَدْ أَسْرَعَ بَنُوكِ. هَادِمُوكِ وَمُخْرِبُوكِ مِنْكِ يَخْرُجُونَ.
e: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.

a: اِرْفَعِي عَيْنَيْكِ حَوَالَيْكِ وَانْظُرِي. كُلُّهُمْ قَدِ اجْتَمَعُوا، أَتَوْا إِلَيْكِ. حَيٌّ أَنَا، يَقُولُ الرَّبُّ، إِنَّكِ تَلْبَسِينَ كُلَّهُمْ كَحُلِيٍّ، وَتَتَنَطَّقِينَ بِهِمْ كَعَرُوسٍ.
e: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.

a: إِنَّ خِرَبَكِ وَبَرَارِيَّكِ وَأَرْضَ خَرَابِكِ، إِنَّكِ تَكُونِينَ الآنَ ضَيِّقَةً عَلَى السُّكَّانِ، وَيَتَبَاعَدُ مُبْتَلِعُوكِ.
e: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

a: يَقُولُ أَيْضًا فِي أُذُنَيْكِ بَنُو ثُكْلِكِ: ضَيِّقٌ عَلَيَّ الْمَكَانُ. وَسِّعِي لِي لأَسْكُنَ.
e: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

a: فَتَقُولِينَ فِي قَلْبِكِ: مَنْ وَلَدَ لِي هؤُلاَءِ وَأَنَا ثَكْلَى، وَعَاقِرٌ مَنْفِيَّةٌ وَمَطْرُودَةٌ؟ وَهؤُلاَءِ مَنْ رَبَّاهُمْ؟ هأَنَذَا كُنْتُ مَتْرُوكَةً وَحْدِي. هؤُلاَءِ أَيْنَ كَانُوا؟».
e: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?

a: هكَذَا قَالَ السَّيِّدُ الرَّبُّ: «هَا إِنِّي أَرْفَعُ إِلَى الأُمَمِ يَدِي وَإِلَى الشُّعُوبِ أُقِيمُ رَايَتِي، فَيَأْتُونَ بِأَوْلاَدِكِ فِي الأَحْضَانِ، وَبَنَاتُكِ عَلَى الأَكْتَافِ يُحْمَلْنَ.
e: Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

a: وَيَكُونُ الْمُلُوكُ حَاضِنِيكِ وَسَيِّدَاتُهُمْ مُرْضِعَاتِكِ. بِالْوُجُوهِ إِلَى الأَرْضِ يَسْجُدُونَ لَكِ، وَيَلْحَسُونَ غُبَارَ رِجْلَيْكِ، فَتَعْلَمِينَ أَنِّي أَنَا الرَّبُّ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْزَى مُنْتَظِرُوهُ».
e: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

a: هَلْ تُسْلَبُ مِنَ الْجَبَّارِ غَنِيمَةٌ؟ وَهَلْ يُفْلِتُ سَبْيُ الْمَنْصُورِ؟
e: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

a: فَإِنَّهُ هكَذَا قَالَ الرَّبُّ: «حَتَّى سَبْيُ الْجَبَّارِ يُسْلَبُ، وَغَنِيمَةُ الْعَاتِي تُفْلِتُ. وَأَنَا أُخَاصِمُ مُخَاصِمَكِ وَأُخَلِّصُ أَوْلاَدَكِ،
e: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

a: وَأُطْعِمُ ظَالِمِيكِ لَحْمَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ، وَيَسْكَرُونَ بِدَمِهِمْ كَمَا مِنْ سُلاَفٍ، فَيَعْلَمُ كُلُّ بَشَرٍ أَنِّي أَنَا الرَّبُّ مُخَلِّصُكِ، وَفَادِيكِ عَزِيزُ يَعْقُوبَ».
e: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
